headers._comment: Everything defaults to revalidate-before-use. Without this, Firebase serves index.html with max-age=3600, so for an hour after every deploy returning visitors keep running the OLD bundle - the new one is on the CDN but nothing asks for it. SPA routes like /donate have no file extension, so only a '**' rule reaches them.
Listed after the catch-all so it wins for these. Vite fingerprints these filenames, so a changed file is a NEW url and can be cached forever - the stale-deploy problem above cannot apply to them.

Security headers, on every response. CSP origins are scoped to what this app actually loads: Google Fonts (index.html), Firebase Auth's REST calls (identitytoolkit/securetoken/googleapis) plus its Google Sign-In popup flow - apis.google.com (the gapi/GIS loader script - a real, deployed CSP violation caught live: apis.google.com/js/api.js got silently blocked, found by chance while checking dark mode, not by testing sign-in directly), accounts.google.com for the OAuth handshake itself (the popup's own page content is a separate top-level navigation not subject to this page's CSP, but the opener page's iframe/script/connect activity during that flow is), and *.firebaseapp.com kept as a fallback even though authDomain (frontend/.env) now points at this app's own ecotrackapp.web.app - Firebase's hidden auth-state iframe is same-origin as a result, which is why frame-src also needs 'self' explicitly: an explicit frame-src directive is NOT backfilled with default-src's 'self', so without this the app's own auth iframe would be the one thing this policy blocked. The Flask API on Vercel (utils/api.js baseURL), Unsplash-hosted photos (utils/photos.js), Pexels-hosted hero video + poster (components/HeroReel.jsx - also caught live, not by desk research), Razorpay's checkout script + its own API calls (utils/razorpay.js, Donate.jsx) - donations open Razorpay's UI inside an iframe/popup it manages itself, hence frame-src - and Google reCAPTCHA v3 (utils/recaptcha.js), which loads its own script from google.com and runs its verification inside a hidden iframe regardless of whether the visible badge is shown. style-src keeps 'unsafe-inline': this app is built with inline style={{...}} throughout every component, and CSP's style-src covers the style attribute as well as <style> tags - dropping unsafe-inline here would blank the entire app, not just tighten it. script-src has no such exception: the one inline script index.html used to have (the pre-paint theme flash fix) was moved to public/theme-init.js specifically so this could be strict.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://*.razorpay.com https://www.google.com/recaptcha/ https://www.gstatic.com/recaptcha/ https://apis.google.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https://images.unsplash.com https://images.pexels.com https://*.razorpay.com; media-src 'self' https://videos.pexels.com; connect-src 'self' https://eco-tracker-hogrider.vercel.app https://*.googleapis.com https://*.razorpay.com https://www.google.com/recaptcha/ https://apis.google.com; frame-src 'self' https://*.razorpay.com https://www.google.com/recaptcha/ https://accounts.google.com https://*.firebaseapp.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
